title: Joshua Completes the Conquest and Destroys the Anakim
description: Joshua takes possession of the entire land from the bare mountain at Seir to Baal-Gad in the valley of Lebanon near Mount Hermon, and captures all their kings, putting them to death. Not a single city made peace with the Israelites, except for the Hivites living in Gibeon—the Lord hardened the hearts of these kings so that they went to war and were devoted to destruction. Joshua also drives out the Anakim from the mountains around Hebron, Debir, and Anab, and from all the hill country of Judah and Israel. Only in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod do some Anakim remain. Finally, Joshua distributes the land as an inheritance among the tribes of Israel, and the land rests from war.
